_note: one-contact-moment-on-several-cases. One telephone call about three cases is one record filed on three cases, not three copies. The set lives on `caseReferences` rather than widening `caseReference`, because `caseReference` is one property on one schema that three facets share and `request` keeps it a single string. On a contact moment `caseReference` mirrors `primaryCaseReference`, so every existing reader keeps working.

caseReferences.title: Case references
caseReferences.description: Every case this contact moment is filed on, in the order it was filed, as ADR-048 semantic references to https://openregister.app/ns#Case. Holds at least one entry and never the same reference twice. Filing onto a further case appends here; it never copies the contact moment.

primaryCaseReference.title: Primary case
primaryCaseReference.description: The one case a surface shows when it can show only one. Always a member of caseReferences, and never answered by position in that set: a reorder must not move the primary. Mirrored onto caseReference so a reader that knows only the single-reference shape still resolves the right case.

caseFilings.title: Filing trail
caseFilings.description: One entry per act that filed this contact moment onto a case or took it off one: which case, which act, who performed it and when. Filing is an act rather than a copy, so the trail is the only record that the second case was added by somebody rather than logged there.

act.title: Act
act.description: Whether the case was added or removed.

by.title: By
by.description: The user id that performed the act.
